objective: Frozen experiment on class-4 algebras whose only failing clean-edge condition is (K) (free class 4 on (1,1), (0,1,1), (1,1,1) at d = 5): for fixed layer-<=2 data on the solution variety, the layer-4 equations of zero-jump gadget knots are affine in the layer-3 data; test on seven graph shapes and three configuration types that the global linear part equals the one assembled from single-edge gadgets and that the constant parts differ by an element of its column space (a triangular relabeling), so the counts agree; test the linear-flow structure (private equations homogeneous linear in slot-2 data, endpoint vertex terms linear in it, vanishing summand terms) and the rank-witness ingredients; controls: the cumulative gadget design, and an algebra whose dual slot has layer-1 data.
status: Closed: supported under its frozen rule (E001). For free class 4 on (1, 1), (0, 1, 1) and (1, 1, 1) at d = 5, on seven graph shapes up to K4 and three configuration types (63 configurations), the global and assembled local layer-4 systems have equal linear parts and constant parts differing by an element of the column space, so counts agree; single edges have the linear-flow structure and the rank-witness ingredients; the cumulative design (non-local already below layer 4) and a dual slot with layer-1 data fail as required.
title: Class-4 gadget counts are local up to a relabeling of layer-3 data
